reason: A multi-channel external-service bridge that connects WeChat, QQ, and Feishu messaging with DeepSeek Harness agents, including inbound routing, outbound replies, channel configuration, and persistent sessions.

summaries.zh: 将微信、QQ和飞书消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，并把智能体回复发送回对应聊天频道的多通道桥接插件。
summaries.en: A multi-channel bridge that routes WeChat, QQ, and Feishu messages to DeepSeek Harness agents and relays their replies back to the originating chats.

capabilities: Receives chat messages from WeChat, QQ, and Feishu
Routes incoming messages to a DeepSeek Harness agent
Sends agent replies back through connected chat channels
Maintains separate persistent sessions per channel
Stores and uses channel authentication credentials
Provides configuration through a web settings interface
